lines: Arthur's voice lines and sound effects.
- "Aoi? Feels like there's someone in my head..."

- "What occurred in that reactor - or what's going to occur - is beyond me. But it looks like we have another chance, and with you steering the ship, we might even make it. If anyone can pull this team together, it's you. And if there's anything I can do, you know where I am."
- "Quincy, I need you to talk to our civilian operatives about updating their surveillance detection routes. I need to know which of them have drawn attention, and who's on them."
- "Amir, I've got updates for civvie stations in the outer sectors. Hand-delivery only. That's you."
- "Lettie: thanks for the help. Appreciate it."
- "Great work on the threat assessment, Aoi. Let's have you run the others through it at the briefing."
- "Situation isn't ideal but confidence is high. I'll take it."
- "We're making a difference. That's a rare feeling in this line of work."
- "We're saving lives here. No matter how rough it gets, remember that."
- "Some of the west sector civvies want to throw us a parade, and I can't seem to convince them that that kind of attention is a bad idea."

path: Rank 4 or Higher with The Hex
lines: - "Hey, no drinking contests with the newcomers. I don't care how patriotic anyone's feeling."
- "Yes, the bar is open. Don't make me regret it."
- "Eleanor. If that guitar... thing... of Flare's has thoughts, I want to know what they are."
- "Amir. I want you and Kaya submitting joint scav dockets from here on in."
- "Quincy. We need a fresh tactical overview. The new four have some bloody useful tricks up their sleeves."
- "Lettie. If Velimir can keep the beer cold, he can keep a morgue running. Tell him I said so."
- "Uh, put me down as a 'maybe' for open mic night. Quincy knows why."
- "Hey, Kaya, once again at Lettie's request: if you, uh, create a portal, um... close it again afterwards."
- "Gentle reminder everyone: Lettie's rats are not test subjects. They know what terminal velocity is and they don't enjoy it."
- "Sol, I wish the Major could see what her family are going through to get her back."
- "The Major was broken. Crawling. Any of us could have killed her then. But we all held back."
- "Whatever the hell is keeping Flare going, it's going to win this war for us."
- "My dad would have taken one look at Flare and written them off as a limp-wristed weakling. It's amazing how wrong he could be, my dad."
- "There are more of us, aren't there? Others. Entrati had so many loops to do what he did."
- "I can't look at mythology like I used to. Now I know what Entrati did to history. Dragons, golems, gorgons... makes you wonder, doesn't it?"
- "Minerva has plagues, Kaya has antimatter... Yeah, Entrati was definitely planning more than just a nuke."
- "Libertatians! Always got to be the loudest in the room. But when the shit goes down, you know they've got your back."
- [singing] "Why dost thou sit upon my grave and will dead lips to speak? Why dost thou weep upon my grave and will not let me sleep?"
- Drifter. The Techrot just registered a monstrous energy loss. It's birthed something. Eleanor says it's imprinted on you.
- "Hop on text for a second. The team got you something."
- "Welcome aboard, Drifter. This is for you."
- "Well done, and well earned. This is for you."
- "With your help we're turning things around. This is for you."
> Entrati had backup plans, and four of them just came knocking. Now that the old Round Table bar's opened its doors again, we can afford to be hospitable.
> Hendricks and Volkov seem to know what they're doing, at least. I've always respected the Libertatian military, even if they do tend to show up late to the party.
> I don't even know where to start with the smart-arse kid and the rock prophet, though.
> Once I'm satisfied that we're secure enough here, I may well ask you to handle them.
- "I admit, when you first came to us I had... reservations. In hindsight that was folly. Here. This is for you."
- "Let me know when you have something."
- "Later, then. Amir! I need your eye on the gennie. Now."
- "Good. Lettie! Can I have a word?"
- "As you were. Quincy. Inventory. What have we got?"
- "Travel safe. Aoi. Any update on enemy movements?"
- "Talk soon, then. How's that issue we discussed, Eleanor?"
- "Oh, and be careful out there, yeah? Don't want to lose you."
- "Well. All right, then. You and me. Yes!"
- "All right, then. Let's give this another go."
- "Right. I'll forget you brought it up then."
- "Yeah, that's not going to happen. Sorry."
- "I need you to be certain. Are you?"
- "Okay." (pause) "Huh. I won't lie, I... I feel like complete shit right now. You'd best not talk to me for a little bit."
- "Yeah... Figures. I'm your disposable doting dipshit once again. Why did I think it would be any different this time."
- "With all my love and respect this is not something you joke about. Please, don't jerk me around."
- "Be careful out there. If you got killed I'd never forgive you."
- "Oh, and if you happen to come across a bottle anywhere? I'm cooking."
- "You will tell me if the stubble gets too much, won't you? Don't want you to feel like a tramp's moved in."
- "Look at you, prowling around your lair. Like you're protecting what's yours."
- "You are giving me quite an appetite, looking like that."
- "Should I get a little pinnie on and do some dusting? Would you like that? I could be persuaded."
- "Helminth isn't watching, Kalymos isn't watching, even Eleanor isn't watching. And I am right here."
- "Sol's wounds, I am bushed. Maybe I should grab a shower. Join if you like."
- "I wonder how robust this furniture is?"
- "Comms are on silent... Aoi's fielding ops... I am officially off duty. This is our time. Just you and me."
- "What we do... is up to us. I could cook us a meal. We could even get drunk! (laugh) Sol. I've missed feeling safe enough to let my guard down."
- "The only thing this place is missing is a nice big open fireplace. Oh, and a rug. Something furry, for wrestling on."
- "Shame I'm not sleepy. It'd be lovely to wake up to your face."
- "We should climb up on the roof. Look at the stars together. Feed the pigeons. Sweep for snipers."
- "I'm not saying it's on the cards, I'm not saying it's even going to happen, but: if Quincy gave me a tattoo, would you laugh?"
- "You know... Aoi always smiles when she sees me heading over here. Like she wants me to know it's all okay."
- "Little reminder. Your weapons need to be stripped down and cleaned regularly. Including me. Do we need to make this a disciplinary matter?"
- "I could still taste you on my lips this morning. Buggered up my concentration completely. You are a liability, you are."
- "Have you been working out? Fancy a quick arm-wrestle? Any bruises, I'll tell Lettie I got them "in action.""
- "Gods. I am such a lucky bastard."
- "Given the sort of stuff we've been getting up to, I think we can be pretty certain you're immune to the Techrot."
- "Hold it. Quiet. Listen. (small pause) All clear. Sorry, I'm twitchy. Old habits."
- "You still got that old Kinepage? Might have to send you a text or two. Just so you know I'm thinking about you."
- "Just be glad I'm not taking you home to meet my parents. One warzone is enough."
- "Kalymos? Hey, hey! Kalymos, c'mere. Come on, come to uncle Arthur. Come on, over here. Don't be scared, come on. (disgruntled) Fine. Be like that."
- "I can't believe you've got a frigging spaceship and you're slumming it, here, with me."
- "Pick me up a black bow tie if you ever find one, okay? I'd look sharp in a black bow tie."
- "Hand on heart, I didn't think we'd make it through the year. The Hex, I mean. Too many ways for it all to fall apart."
- "My sister thinks the world of you, you know. And where you're concerned, I actually care what she thinks."
- "Amir will be fine by himself, won't he? I don't have to watch over him 24/7, do I?"
- "Wonder what Entrati's up to now. Sleeping with one eye open, if he's got any sense."
- "To what do I owe the pleasure?"
- (Deep voice, cockney accent) " 'ello, darlin'." (Awkward laugh) "Sorry, I won't do that again."
- "Just thinking, I'd make a shit father, but a really great uncle. The sort who takes you to the woods to blow things up."
- "We should get a distillery going, since we're here for good now. I could make my home brew. Nightingale's Old Kneecapper."
- "I promised myself I'd protect Eleanor forever. Nobody would ever hurt my sister again. Bollocksed that up nicely, didn't I?"
- "Just hoping I get to go out riding with you someday. Horses, or Kaithes, or whatever they have wherever we end up."
- "All this? This is so much more than I deserve."
- "When I look at the others, everything they have going for them, I just think: out of all of them, I got chosen. Me. You're crazy. But - but - don't change your mind."
- "Sorry. I was just thinking about how I had to watch all of them die, one by one. My head knows that didn't happen. We won. But I can still feel the despair down in my guts."
- "You don't take nearly enough time for yourself. The world will not break if your set it down from your shoulders once in a while. Took me long enough to learn that."
- "Caught myself daydreaming about the big country house with the enormous garage." (laugh) "I used to drive Aoi mental talking about that dream." (sigh) "I hope she finds someone."
- "It's daft eh? I was just thinking about Ordis, actually. What he'd look like if he was a person again. Little fella in a butler coat. Like a penguin."
- "You've given me a reason to be scared of dying, and that much more to live for."
- "Thank the Gods for Höllvania's vibrant dating scene."
- "Yeah. If I was someone else I'd be so jealous of me right now."
- "So am I. What we've got here... it's really good. So let's not take it for granted. Make each day count."
- "Thanks for saying it. I mean it. I could never get tired of hearing you say that to me."
- "Me too. I'm so bloody glad we talk as much as we do. I bottled too much stuff up for too long."
- "You say stuff like that out of the blue, you just make me fall in love with you all over again."
- "So am I. And... so are the others. I was a moody old pain in the arse before you made an honest man of me."
- "Just how 'glad' are you, hm? Do I get to send you on your next mission looking all disheveled and breathless?"
- "Let me know if you need me."
> You changed my life forever, in the best of ways. I still can't believe you and I found each other.
> Here's to seeing in the New Year together, and the promise of many more to come.
- "I remember thinking: "I could die happy right now. But please, not yet."."
- "That was the only victory worth fighting for. You."
- "Standing there in your arms amid all the insanity, I was finally home."
- "In that moment, with fireworks in the sky and hope in the air at last, I felt reborn."
- "I was so afraid. Even then. I never wanted to let you go."
- "Need my Tommy keys, Amir. I'm not letting another lead on Entrati go to waste."
- "My keys better not be in that mess."
- "No disrespect, Quincy. Got places to be, is all."
- "Got a lead on Entrati. Sewers. Arse deep in Techrot, most likely. I'm going after him, for all our sakes. Lettie, look, if you've taken my keys again..."
- "No one's bailing. I got us into this, and if it kills me, I'll get us- fine. Aoi, Amir, Quincy on backup. Lettie, you and Eleanor hold the fort here, keep the gennies running."
- "He's here. Deep in the Techrot. I'm going after him."
- "If it's bullshit, I'll feed Marty here to the Techrot myself. But the clock's running out."
- "Well, you're on point, Marty. But you try any of those head games again and there won't be much left for Lettie to stitch back up. You read me?"
- "Cut the chatter. 19 hours til we're popping corks, or vaporized. We get Entrati and put a stop to this."
- "Holding cells ahead. Big moment for you, Marty."
- "You better have him. Marty? Is Entrati there?"
- "Bollocks! Get your arse out of there! Quincy, Aoi, we need fire support!"
- "So what do you want me to do, Lettie?"
- "So where's Entrati? You said this was a loop."
- "Stow it, Lettie! Amir. Talk to me. Is your plan ready?"
- "Quincy and Marty, keep the air clean while the rest of us search the tunnels for a terminal. You too, Lettie."
- "Eleanor, you sensing any civilians down here?"
- "So. Wherever they're hiding out, it's above ground. That's a mercy."
- "She showed up after the hack. Uh. Look. Marty. Maybe we got off on the wrong-"
- "If there's a chance he's on it, we have to try. Only he can stop this."
- "Just haul arse to Aoi. Rest of us will catch up."
- "-North's your best bet. Mountains might be a chance against the fallout."
- "You said it yourself, Lettie. Bad odds. Eleanor. I'm asking. Please."
- "Viktor, you love this city. Y2K is gonna haywire the plant. Call off your dogs for the night and help us."
- "Show off. Better make a move, though. They'll get on you."
- "That bastard wants to flatten this city just to be king of the rubble. Need you to break past Scaldra barricades and turn Viktor's tank into a scrap heap."
- "Bollocks. His tanks are here to tighten his stranglehold on Höllvania. Marking a tank. Let's ruin his day."
- "Price of protection. Viktor writes the cheques and the people of Höllvania pay with their lives. Get in there and take those tanks out."
- "Is that so? Alright, Hex, how about we show Viktor where we stand. Trash that tank."
- "Hear that? If only we'd all bowed to that massive ego earlier, we wouldn't be in the mess. Huh, well, way I see it, no reason to start now. Let's take out his tank."
- "Disappearance? So they don't know where she is either. Time to press our luck, your target is Viktor's beloved H-09."
- Viktor: "It's time for the Hex to learn that movement isn't free. RRRRRRRRats! On the streets! Of my city! Ah-gain! Erect the barricades."
- Viktor: "Move the H-09 into position. Cover flanks with ferrocite barricades. Nothing touches my baby."
- Viktor: "Barricades up. Nothing gets through ferrocite."
- Viktor: "Quickly, the Hex have been spotted. Engage the barricades, seal the sector."
- "Ferrocite barricades? Need something to cut through those, but it won't be easy. Step one, acquire a Transponder from someone with rank."
- "Sol damned! Ferrocite barricades, nothing you got can get past those. Except... Okay. First step, get your hands on a Scaldra Commander's Transponder."
- "Ferrocite barricades? That's new. Okay, you need Thermian explosive, to get that, take out Scaldra until you find an Emergency Transponder."
- "More ferrocite. You know what to do, call in another squad of Stormfall and get your greedy mitts on their RPGs."
- "Another barrier. Viktor really want to keep us out. Get your hands on a thermian RPG and take it down."
- "Oh look, another barrier. Does Viktor really think this will stop us?"
If players take too long to pick up a transponder...
- "Find an Emergency Transponder. I don't see another way."
- "You need to find an Emergency Transponder."
- "That's our ticket. Now get to a comms terminal. Use that to call in reinforcements... for them. Hey, never said this would be easy."
- "Congratulations on your promotion commander. Now, get to a Comms Terminal and use that thing to call-in Stormfall paratroopers. Yeah, you heard me right."
If players take too long to hack a terminal...

- "Come on. You're never gonna get through that barrier without Thermian RPGs. And to get those you need to call in the only units that get issued them. Understand? Take an Emergency Transponder to the terminal and call in reinforcements."
- "Stormfall paratroopers inbound. Wrestle those RPGs from their cold, dead, hands."
- "Stormfall squad deploying. Watch the skies, intercept and capture a Thermian RPG."
- "That did it. Stormfall squad coming. You want their Thermian weaponry."
- "Stormfall Squad inbound. Lock and load, these are the big boys, 'cause they don't trust the rookies with the heavy hardware."
- "That did it! Armor plating must be Ferrocite. Do it again."
If players take too long to use the RPG...
- "Get your hands on a Thermian RPG and shoot down the barrier. Don't make me ask you again."
- "Grab a Thermian RPG, point it at the barrier and pull the trigger. Simple as that."
- "You're not making any progress. See if you can find a Thermian rocket?"
- "Ooo, you trying to get fancy? They've detected your breach and raised the security level. Breach their systems again and their resistance is only going to get more fierce."
- "Bold move. Security level just ratcheted up. If you got a death wish, this is one way to get your wish granted."
- "You deliberately trying to make this harder? Keep breaching their security and you'll get exactly what you're asking for."
- "Oh... You've really kicked the hornet's nest now. Full Alert active. Hope you know what you're doing."
- "Security at Full Alert. Brilliant. You know, you could have kept things simple. In and out. Job done. Why do you always have to make things so complicated?"
- "Security at Full Alert. One tank not enough for you? You had to call in all of Scaldra? Tell you what - make it out alive and I'll buy you a beer."
- "This isn't your city. We're here to evict you."
- "I'd ask you the same, but I don't believe there's anyone who'd rightly call you friend, Viktor."
- "Oh Viktor, you really are the most insufferable prick."
- "About as effective as anything else you've done to stop the Techrot."
- "This pillock is going to get this entire town killed. Mark my words."
- "Never waste a crisis, right Viktor? Oh, how I wish you understood just how outmatched you were, and I don't mean by us."
- "A mercy would be you shutting up."
- "Don't look now, but you've got a Stormfall squad coming your way. Want to find out what their Thermian rockets will do to that thing's armor?"
- "Amir's intel suggests the armor's weakest around the vents."
- "Um... Try hitting the exhaust vents. Worked in a movie I saw once."
- "It's gotta have a weakness. Try the vents."
- "Aim for the vents. Just above the treads."
- "Amir's getting strange readings from that tank. You better finish it off quick."
- "I've got a bad feeling. Finish it off fast."
- "Ah, Viktor, Viktor, Viktor, what have you been downloading?"
- "That's not Viktor's tank anymore. Doesn't mean it doesn't want you less dead. Take it down."
- "Ugh! Looks like Viktor forgot to update his antivirus software. Now you gotta clean up his mess."
- "Now do you see what you're dealing with, Viktor. You can't control this. You can't manage it, or exploit it. Hex, let's show Viktor how it's done, finish that thing."
- "Uh, just, look for the soft bits and hit it there."
- "Something tells me that thing won't like it if you pop its zits."
- "Tank's healing itself. Just like we do."
- "Techrot regeneration. You'll need to find a way to make the damage stick."
- "Ugh, bloody hell. Nothing ever comes easy in this town, does it? But you did good today. Now get yourself out of there."
- "Now it's dead. Viktor has no idea what he's up against. Head home. Rest up. We've got more to do tomorrow."
- "Okay. Aoi says: "Tell the Drifter they are now being hunted by On-lyne, only it's not them, it's the Techrot, it stole their shapes, oh sweet Lua, this is horrible. Emoticon. Emoticon. Emoticon.""
- "Techrot's awake. Hungry. Taking on a new form. I think it's trying to become... the, uh... On-lyne boys..?"
- "It turns out Aoi's conspiracy theories were true: On-lyne really have been cloned and used to create Techrot parodies. I'm sorry to say you just attracted their attention."
- "Drifter, new Techrot Coda just hatched. Tracking your Void-saturated DNA signature. Has an expiry date of... never. You might be stuck with this one for a while."
- "If Amir's take on the situation is accurate you are now being stalked by a knockoff clone of a popular late twentieth century boyband. If you need backup, you know where to find us."

- "Viruses are dangerous, Techrot viruses are lethal. The one you just created has based itself on On-lyne for reasons I can't even pretend to fathom. But I doubt mimicking a boyband will make it any less of a headache."
- "You have to admit, this is an improvement."
- "Well, what kind of hellscape adventure are we on today?"
- "Never a dull moment with you, eh?"
- "They don't stand a chance against us."
- "This is exactly what I'm trained for."
- "My day just got a whole lot better."
- "We work well together, don't we, love?"
- "No one I'd rather be fighting beside."
- "Any excuse to be by your side? I'll take."
- "You and me, here we go again."
- "I know how you can make this up to me later."
- "I don't think they know what they're up against, do they, babe?"
- "You don't mind a bit of stubble, do you?"
- "Just remember, when we're like this, you feel what I feel."
- "So, what's your plan? Take this body for a spin, then shower it down after?"
- "I have to admit, this is weirdly romantic."
- "So, what romantic adventure are we off to?"
- "Nobody lays a hand on my Drifter."
- "Just... don't go peeking while you're in there. Your birthday gifts are on order."
- "Us against the universe? They don't stand a chance."
- "Huh. Off on a jolly, are we?"
- "If you wouldn't mind, pick us up a coffee while you're out."
- "Give us a yell when you're ready."
- "Get some rest. You must be chinstrapped."
- "Off you go. I'll put my feet up."
- "Slip me on like a body bag, why don't you."
- "Remember, if we get hurt, I feel it."
- "Six P's: Prior Planning Prevents Piss-Poor Performance. You're ready?"
- "Still can't believe I let you do this."
- "The kitty is in the basket. Let's roll."
- "Think it's gonna get a bit tasty."
- "We appear to have angered the locals."
- "Hostiles! Contain them before it's a ball of chalk!"
- "I need a cup of tea and a lie down."
- "There really was no need for that."
- "Let's call it a day, shall we?"
- "Can I get a hand over here?"
- "Why the hell did I let that happen?"
- "Can I please get a hand up?"
- "I'll be fine. Just get me up."
- "Oi. Took one to the side. Staple me up."
- "Down! Cleaning it out. Just need a hand up."
- "I went down like a sack of spuds."
- "The only thing wounded is my dignity."
- "Don't fuss. You're like my maiden aunt."
- "Let's mop up these dipsticks and get home."
- "Let's get this show on the road."

path: Höllvania Central Mall 2024 Demo Idle Quotes
lines: - "One day, Aoi. No more roadblocks and checkpoints. Just you and me and the bikes, open road for miles, all this bullshit far away. I swear to Sol."
- "Still too open. We need more chokepoints."
- "We'll find you, Doctor. That's a promise."
- "Dunno why we even bothered with that cleaning rota."
- "Stop sniffing around my head, Eleanor. If I want to talk, I'll talk."
- "Question. Could I take Quincy down if he turned on me?"
- "Well, Amir's still alive. That's a win."
- "We need to keep Lettie on her feet. If she goes, we all go."
- "Sol help us if these arcade games wind up Infested."
- "Nah. I'm not going to let this slide that easily..."
- "Okay. Plan A it is. I'll take point, make the rendezvous solo. Aoi, Amir, Quincy on backup. Lettie, you and Eleanor hold the fort here, keep the gennies running."
- "Well... let's find out, then. Needs must, and all that."
- "I'm not worrying. Honestly. But sometimes I think... what if, one day, you just punch the floor again and all this goes away? Like a dream that I don't even get to remember?"
